cases.summary: Dashboard fits on a single screen with no scrolling
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.input: 1. Open the main dashboard after login.
cases.expected: Dashboard content is visible on one screen. No horizontal or vertical scrolling is required.

cases.summary: Dashboard shows the listed sections
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.input: 1. Observe Agent Information, Search, Activity History, Balance Card, QR Code, Action Buttons, Performance, Footer.
cases.expected: Those sections are present. Banner is not asserted (REQ-022 has no trigger).

cases.summary: Agent Information shows Agent Name when available
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.expected: Agent Name is displayed (source: Get User Details). Do not use a secret value; match the name returned for the inventory agent.

cases.summary: Agent Information falls back to Agent MSISDN when name is unavailable
cases.preconditions: Logged in with an account whose Get User Details has no Agent Name
cases.expected: Agent MSISDN is displayed in Agent Information.
cases.traceability: SAA-909; REQ-003; If Agent Name is unavailable, display Agent MSISDN

cases.summary: Search icon opens in-app search
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.expected: Search for app sections and content is available. Result layout is not specified (Q-001).

cases.summary: History lists current-day app transactions only
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation; at least one same-day app transaction exists
cases.expected: Only activities from today 00:00–23:59 that were performed through the app are listed.

cases.summary: Filter by Action Type
cases.preconditions: Activity History has more than one action type today
cases.expected: List shows only the selected action type. Total revenue at the bottom is recalculated.
cases.traceability: SAA-909; REQ-006, REQ-008; Filter by Action Type

cases.summary: Filter by Keyword / Number search
cases.preconditions: Activity History has a known number or keyword
cases.expected: Matching transactions remain. Revenue is recalculated after filtering.
cases.traceability: SAA-909; REQ-006, REQ-008; Keyword / Number Search

cases.summary: Transactions are in chronological order
cases.preconditions: At least two same-day transactions
cases.input: 1. Open Activity History with no filter.
cases.expected: Transactions are sorted chronologically. Record whether newest-first or oldest-first (Q-002).
cases.traceability: SAA-909; REQ-007; Transactions sorted in chronological order

cases.summary: Supported history types can appear in the list
cases.preconditions: Same-day transactions exist for Registration, Re-identification, SIM Swap, Upgrade Account, Upgrade KYC, Airtime, Bundle
cases.input: 1. Open Activity History. 2. Filter or scan by type.
cases.expected: Each of the seven stored types can appear when a matching same-day transaction exists.

cases.summary: Airtime balance is present after PIN validation
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.expected: Airtime (Yas) balance area is present. Refresh latency is not asserted (Q-003).

cases.summary: Balance is hidden by default and revealed with the Eye icon
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.input: 1. Observe the amount. 2. Tap the Eye icon.
cases.expected: Amount is hidden by default. After Eye, the amount is revealed.
cases.traceability: SAA-909; REQ-011; Hidden by default, Eye icon

cases.summary: QR code is shown as the agent identifier
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.input: 1. Observe the QR on the dashboard.
cases.expected: QR code is visible for the logged-in agent.
cases.traceability: SAA-909; REQ-012; QR Code — Available for all agents

cases.summary: Tapping QR expands it with Agent MSISDN above
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.expected: QR expands to full screen. Agent MSISDN is displayed above it.

cases.summary: Buttons with authorized=true are displayed
cases.preconditions: Agent Profile Mapping has at least one authorized=true action
cases.expected: Buttons whose mapping is authorized=true are displayed.
cases.traceability: SAA-909; REQ-014; Authorized = true → Button displayed

cases.summary: Buttons with authorized=false are hidden
cases.preconditions: Agent Profile Mapping has at least one authorized=false action
cases.expected: Buttons whose mapping is authorized=false are not displayed.
cases.traceability: SAA-909; REQ-014; Authorized = false → Button hidden

cases.summary: Freelancer / Staff dashboard shows the listed sections and three common actions
cases.preconditions: Logged in as Freelancer 1, Freelancer 2, or Staff
cases.expected: Search, Activity History, Agent Information, Airtime Balance, Performance, Client Registration, Airtime & Bundle, Customer Services are present. Banner not asserted.
cases.traceability: SAA-909; REQ-015; Dashboard by User Type — Freelancer / Staff

cases.summary: Team Leader dashboard additionally shows Agent Out of Stock and Reload
cases.preconditions: Logged in as Team Leader
cases.expected: Team Leader sees the Freelancer/Staff set plus Agent Out of Stock and Reload.

cases.summary: Performance shows at most two KPI cards with current and previous-day comparison
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.expected: At most 2 KPI cards. Current value and previous-day comparison are shown. Gross Add at D+1 is not asserted unless D+1 data is present.
cases.traceability: SAA-909; REQ-017; Performance Section — General Rules

cases.summary: Each KPI uses the stated comparison baseline
cases.preconditions: KPI values are available from agentPerformance API
cases.input: 1. Read each visible KPI comparison label.
cases.expected: Registration, Certification, Active Agents, Airtime Sales, Reload, POS Out of Stock compare vs Yesterday. Gross Add compares vs Target.

cases.summary: Indicator is Up/Green, Down/Red, or Horizontal/Orange
cases.preconditions: Controllable KPI data for current > / < / = comparison
cases.input: 1. Observe the indicator on a KPI where current is greater, lower, then equal.
cases.expected: Greater: Up, Green. Lower: Down, Red. Equal: Horizontal, Orange. Hex values are not specified.

cases.summary: Team Leader performance shows cumulative team KPIs
cases.preconditions: Logged in as Team Leader
cases.expected: Values are cumulative team performance for Registration, Certification, Gross Add, Active Agents with today, yesterday, and trend.

cases.summary: Footer is visible with Home, Notifications, My Account
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.input: 1. Observe the footer. 2. Tap Home, Notifications, My Account in turn.
cases.expected: Footer is visible. Home opens Main Dashboard. Notifications opens Notification Centre. My Account opens Profile / Self-Care.

cases.summary: Banner display depends on downstream API — expected content not stated
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.input: 1. Observe whether a banner is present.
cases.expected: Cannot be expected-resulted. Banner content, count and trigger are not in the ticket.
